name: Oriole Orchards
description: A small apple orchard in Red Hook, NY, Oriole Orchards grows Apples, Pears, Peaches, Nectarines, and Cherries. The orchard is busiest in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
